rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The record dated 15 November 2003 is headed as the resignation address of 土井たか子党首.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: 土井たか子 tells the representatives' meeting that she has decided to resign as party leader and that she is stating her resignation to them at the opening of the meeting today.

locator.section: 本日は都道府県連合代表者会議の冒頭に

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: 土井たか子 recalls that on the 11th the three party officers met and accepted her resignation.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: 土井たか子 recalls that on the 13th the regular standing executive committee received her statement of intent to resign.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: 土井たか子 recalls that in 1996 she took over from 村山富市前党首 and that her time as leader began with the general election immediately after.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: 土井たか子 tells the meeting that at the joint plenary meeting of both houses' members held just before, 福島瑞穂さん was chosen as the new party leader.
